seed: Premiere's Command R, Speed/Duration: with the panel put away, Command R on a cut recording brings the panel back, puts the Time section on screen and drops the Speed list open for the piece a click picked. Picking 2x retimes that piece, one undo step. At Next defaults, no flag set.

steps.comment: Cut at two seconds, then stand in the second piece.

steps.note: an eight second recording cut at two seconds, the playhead at six, and the panel put away with the title bar's toggle. The split left the first piece picked

steps.comment: Click the second piece on the timeline, the way a person picks it.

steps.note: THE TEST: one press of Command R brought the panel back, the Time section is on screen and its Speed list is open for piece 2 of 2, the piece the click picked. Under a walk the list is held open on its face rather than put on screen, so the face wears its open edge
picking 2x from the list Command R opened sped the second piece up: six seconds of recording now run in three, and the bar, the dropdown and the clip line all say 2x
Command Z took the speed back in one step

steps.comment: Fold the Time section by a click on its header.

steps.note: the Time section folded by its header, so the Speed list is out of sight
THE TEST: Command R opened the folded Time section and dropped its Speed list open
